entries.8dbef0f31c5d4843: This business manufactures and sells functional resins and films, including Poval resin and film, ＰＶＢ resin and film, and ＥＶＯＨ resin (EVAL), and is the reportable segment with the largest revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥387,169 million. The MD&A states that sales volume did not increase as much as expected due to the stagnation of the European economy. Sales volume of water-soluble Poval film increased on rising demand for individually packaged detergents, and sales volume of optical Poval film increased due to measures supporting appliance replacement in China, among others.

entries.cad555bb2bb5e10a: This business manufactures and sells methacrylic resins, medical-related products (dental materials), activated carbon, water treatment products and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥202,208 million. Dental materials for aesthetic treatment performed well, centered on Europe and the United States. Sales volume of activated carbon increased, centered on drinking water applications, but some customers reviewed their purchase timing due to U.S. tariff policies and others, and volume did not reach the expected level. Production capacity for methyl methacrylate and others has been reduced since July 2025.
